definitions.explanation: Pellets of ice that fall from cumulonimbus clouds during storms. Larger than sleet, and can cause damage to crops and property.

examples.japanese: {雹|ひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた。
{雹|ひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボンネット→ボンネット：28602_bonnetto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧へこんだ。
examples.english: The car hood got dented by the hail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕立|ゆうだち}→夕立：05862_yuudachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大粒|おおつぶ}→大粒：15833_ootsubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雹|ひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧、⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Large hailstones fell during a summer evening shower, causing damage to crops.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{霰|あられ}→霰：05392_arare⟧: sleet/graupel (smaller ice pellets, under 5mm)
- {雹|ひょう}: hail (larger ice pellets, 5mm or more)

The meteorological distinction is based on size: ice pellets under 5mm are classified as ⟦{霰|あられ}→霰：05392_arare⟧, while those 5mm and above are {雹|ひょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雹|ひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: hail falls
- {雹|ひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: hail damage
- ⟦{大粒|おおつぶ}→大粒：15833_ootsubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雹|ひょう}: large hailstones
